player_code: the ticker suffix of a team contract (for example HURR); the contract ending in -TIE is never bought
start_rule: the ticker key starts with the date and a four-digit clock time: the scheduled start S, read as US Eastern time. Checked once for the family: the share of development matches whose market closed 4 to 90 minutes after S is printed; under 80% the family is 'start not derivable' and nothing is scored.

stage_1_slice.note: the slice INPLAYJUMP already lists; counts and cost only, no bet scored

held_out.note: not listed and not pulled until the Head's go

constants.before_instant: candle ending at the EARLIER match's S minus 2 minutes, in the LATER match's market
constants.after_instant: candle ending at the later match's S minus 6 minutes
constants.entry_instant: close of the candle ending at the later match's S minus 5 minutes
constants.fee: 0.07 x price x (1 - price), rounded up to the next cent
constants.decision_minute: candle ending at the later match's S minus 6 minutes

amendments: the registration file's dated amendments override this file where they differ
